name: Nexus Agent Core
description: Nexus Agent Core. Stage 1: the Task module (tools nexus_task_*, RPC nexus.task.*, open-Task prompt list), off by default. Stage 0 runtime spikes remain behind spikesEnabled (see DESIGN.md section 13).

tasksEnabled.description: Enable the Stage 1 Task module: nexus_task_* tools (optional tools, allow them via tools.allow), nexus.task.* gateway methods, the open-Task prompt list and the nexus.sqlite store. Off by default.

ownerId.description: MVP owner id placeholder (DESIGN section 5). Not a security boundary. Defaults to "local".

spikesEnabled.description: Register the Stage 0 spike probes (gateway methods nexus.spike.*, tool nexus_spike_probe, probe service). Off by default so the plugin is inert.

spikeStopDelayMs.description: Spike 3 item 4: delay the probe service stop() by this many ms to observe the reload stop timeout.

spikeStartFailOnce.description: Spike 3 item 4: make the first probe service start() throw once to observe start-failure retry.
